scope: Two source-checked Lil wedding chapter records only; original allocations and speaker09 retained.

records.english: {SPEAKER:09}You'll always have me by your side to protect you.{PAD}
records.speaker: Camille Marinus Overijssel
records.context: Lil chapter70: Camille reassures Lil during his confession before the later wedding.
records.source_meaning: Camille promises that he will always be at Lil's side and protect her, whatever happens.
records.localization_note: Combines the two emphatic promises into one idiomatic sentence; always preserves the unrestricted commitment. The formatter owns the break, eliminating the orphan final word without a manual break or alignment space.

records.english: {SPEAKER:09}Better hurry! Dressing up like this took me forever!{PAD}
records.speaker: Camille Marinus Overijssel
records.context: Lil chapter70: Camille rushes to the wedding after struggling with unfamiliar formal clothes, immediately before his surprised apology and the original wedding movie.
records.source_meaning: Camille realizes he must hurry. Unaccustomed to clothes like these, he has taken too long getting dressed.
records.localization_note: Localizes the unfamiliar formal attire and resulting dressing delay as dressing up like this took me forever. Avoids the false garment-specific dress reading of 服. Better hurry is Camille's natural self-directed urgency.
